title: Three Nights and One Short Rod
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：lightning　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lightning 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the observer ① watched the lightning that no farmer in the valley would have recorded, and he said the watching was the whole of the night. The ② lightning, meaning the fire itself and not the rod, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book; lightning, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ flash of lightning in that valley had the same short rod beside it, and the ④ lightning at the far roof, meaning the spark they kept for the children to watch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Lightning, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the observer said the recording is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lightning was the whole of the matter, meaning the warning and not the fire. The ⑥ lightning, meaning the warning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lightning, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both fire and a warning. He said the warning is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ lightning had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short rod. The ⑧ lightning of the whole thing, the observer wrote in July, was one valley and three nights of recording; lightning, he said, is either the spark at the far roof or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lightning I remember is the lightning recorded in the log, which closed in 1978 and is still recorded as the quietest in the valley. ⑩ Lightning, my mother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all lightning, she said, is a warning that has agreed to look like fire. She said the warning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 闪电；雷电（指山谷里每一道旁边的那一道）
B. n. 闪电；雷电（指那道闪电本身，与避雷针相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the lightning 守看这道闪电
D. n. 闪电；雷电（指留给孩子们看的那一星火那一道）
E. n. 雷雨之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的闪电之事）
F. n. 闪电；雷电（指气象记录里写到、被记载的的那一道）
G. n. 警示、天威（指一件事里人人都怕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 天威（抽象总称，指人人都怕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: watched the lightning that no farmer in the valley would have recorded
The lightning, meaning the fire itself and not the rod
Every flash of lightning in that valley
the lightning at the far roof
the lightning was the whole of the matter
the lightning had become a line in a log
The lightning of the whole thing

answers.why: watch the lightning 意为“守看这道闪电”，1971 年那位观测员把山谷里没有一位农人肯记载的一道闪电做了一遍。
lightning 意为“闪电；雷电”，指那道闪电本身而不是避雷针，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。
lightning 意为“闪电；雷电”，指山谷里每一道旁边的那一道，每一道旁边都有同一根细细的避雷针。
lightning 意为“闪电；雷电”，指最远那片屋顶留给孩子们看的那一星火那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lightning 意为“警示、天威”，指一件事里人人都怕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个警示就是那件事的全部。
lightning 意为“天威”，指人人都怕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那道闪电，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lightning 意为“闪电；雷电”，指气象记录里写到、被记载的的那一道，到 1976 年这一道成了气象记录里的一行。
lightning 意为“雷雨之事”，观测员七月写道，整件事的闪电之事是一处山谷和三个夜晚的记载。
lightning 意为“闪电；雷电”，我记得的是气象记录里记载过的那一道，1978 年记下了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一道。
lightning 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，闪电是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的闪电。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年那位观测员守看了山谷里没有一位农人肯记载的一道闪电，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（watch the lightning）
那道闪电，指的是那道闪电本身而不是避雷针，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。（lightning）
那处山谷里每一道闪电旁边都有同一根细细的避雷针。（lightning）
最远那片屋顶那道闪电，指的是他们留给孩子们看的那一星火那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（lightning）
叔叔说这个警示就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那道闪电。（lightning）
1980 年母亲说，闪电是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的闪电。（lightning）

The lightning, meaning the fire itself and not the rod, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book.
Every flash of lightning in that valley had the same short rod beside it.
The lightning at the far roof, meaning the spark they kept for the children to watch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the lightning was the whole of the matter, meaning the warning and not the fire.
